description: The SHAPE of a periodic report, as data: which sections a 10-Q has, in what order, filled from where. A farm that has never filed one needs the structure before it needs the numbers, and adding a section its lender started asking for must not be a code release. THE SECTIONS ARE A CHILD TABLE rather than a JSON blob because they are queried — the skeleton generator walks them, the completeness check counts them — and a blob would mean parsing to answer 'which sections are required'.

fields.description: The template's name, and part of its docname — '10-Q Sections', 'Lender Quarterly Package'. Short and stable: a Disclosure Checklist points at it.
fields.label: Template Name

fields.description: Whose report this is. Required, and part of the docname — two entities on one site file separately and a template shared between them would be a template neither could edit without changing the other's report.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: What cadence this template is for. A CLOSED LIST because it is what the skeleton generator matches on when somebody asks for 'the quarterly template' without naming one.
fields.label: Report Type

fields.description: A disabled template is not offered and is not used by a generated skeleton. It is how a report nobody files any more is withdrawn WITHOUT deleting a template that finished reports still point at.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: The report's title as it prints, in English. Falls back to the template name when empty.
fields.label: Label (EN)

fields.description: The title in Spanish. Empty means English is served and the gap is reported — never a half-translated document.
fields.label: Label (ES)

fields.description: What requires this report — 'SEC Form 10-Q, Part I Item 2', 'credit agreement §6.1(b)', 'nothing, we do it for ourselves'. The last is a real and useful answer.
fields.label: Regulatory Basis

fields.description: The report's sections, in order, each naming where its numbers come from.
fields.label: Sections

fields.description: Set on the templates this app seeds. An operator's own edits to a shipped template are never overwritten by a later migrate — the seeder writes only where nothing exists.
fields.label: Shipped Default

name: Reporting Template
